codes.title: Application key is not valid
codes.problem: the application key is not valid
codes.cause: An application key is 64 lowercase hex digits. A copied key may be cut short or use capital letters.
codes.fix: Scan the host's QR code again, or copy the application key again from holebridge app-key on the host.

codes.title: No application key
codes.problem: there is no application key for this deployment
codes.cause: Each deployment has one application key. It is made at install or first run, and an app gets it from a host's QR code or link.
codes.fix: On the host, run holebridge app-key --new to create one. In the app, scan the host's QR code or open its link.

codes.title: app.key readable by others
codes.problem: app.key can be read by other users
codes.cause: The file holds the application key, a secret for the whole deployment. The host and the relay will not start while others can read it.

codes.title: Config is not valid
codes.cause: A value in host.json is missing or wrong, or no config directory is set. The detail names what is wrong.
codes.fix: Fix the value the detail names, in host.json, or set --config or HOLEBRIDGE_CONFIG.

codes.title: host.json readable by others
codes.problem: host.json can be read by other users
codes.cause: The file holds the host key.

codes.title: Pairing code expired
codes.cause: A pairing code works for 5 minutes, so an old code is not accepted.
codes.fix: On the TV, choose Add from phone again to show a new code.

codes.title: Phone cannot reach the TV
codes.problem: the phone cannot reach the TV
codes.cause: The phone and the TV are not on the same network, or the network keeps devices apart. Guest networks often do.
codes.fix: Use the same network, not a guest network with client isolation.

codes.title: Engine output out of step
codes.problem: a malformed frame arrived on the worklet's stdout
codes.cause: Native code can still write to fd 1 directly.
codes.fix: The app restarts its engine on its own. If this keeps happening, report it with this code.

codes.title: Key is not valid
codes.cause: A key is 9 symbols from 0 to 9 and A to Z, except U. Case, dashes and spaces do not matter.
codes.fix: Type the key shown by holebridge key on the host, or scan its QR code.

codes.title: LAN port already in use
codes.problem: a LAN port is already taken
codes.cause: Another program, or a second host on this machine, is using the port.
codes.fix: Stop the other program, or set other lan.port and lan.discoveryPort values in host.json.

codes.title: Connection limit reached
codes.problem: the host is at one of its limits
codes.cause: Too many connections or streams are open at once. The host caps them so that no one client can use up its resources.
codes.fix: Close some connections and try again. The host owner can raise a limit under limits in host.json.

codes.title: Host not found
codes.problem: the app could not reach the host
codes.cause: No host answered for this key. The host may be off, the key may be mistyped or from another deployment, or the network may block the connection.
codes.fix: Check that the host is running and that the key is right. The app keeps trying on its own.

codes.title: Relay refused the connection
codes.problem: the relay did not accept this key
codes.cause: Only one side has the relay key, or the two sides have different relay keys.
codes.fix: Put the same relay key in host.json (relay) and in the app under Settings, Relay.

codes.title: Service refused the connection
codes.cause: Nothing is listening at the service's target, or the service turned the connection down.
codes.fix: Start the service, or correct its target in host.json.

codes.title: Service did not answer in time
codes.problem: the service did not answer in time
codes.cause: The host could not connect to the service within 10 seconds. The service may be busy or stopped, or its target may be wrong.
codes.fix: Check that the service is running and that its target in host.json is right.

codes.title: UDP datagram too large
codes.problem: a datagram is larger than maxDatagram (1144 bytes by default)
codes.cause: A UDP datagram must fit in one encrypted packet. Larger ones are dropped, because HoleBridge does not split them.
codes.fix: Make the application send smaller UDP packets.

codes.title: Unknown service
codes.problem: the host has no service with this name
codes.cause: The name is not in the host's service list, or the app's copy of the list is out of date.
codes.fix: Check the name with holebridge service ls on the host, then reconnect the app.

codes.title: Bad command line
codes.problem: the command line is not valid
codes.cause: A command, option or value is missing or not known.
codes.fix: Run holebridge --help to see the commands and options.

codes.title: App and host versions differ
codes.problem: the app and the host speak different protocol versions
codes.cause: The app and the host run different protocol versions, which may not work together.
codes.fix: Update the app from its store, or re-run the install script on the host.
